Definition: an Apherasite or inhabitant of an unknown region of Assyria
BiblicalUsage: The Apharsites appear once, named among the peoples settled in Samaria who wrote to Artaxerxes against the Jews rebuilding Jerusalem. A single mention, and it is a letter of complaint.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe one verse is enough to place them: they are remembered for standing against the work, and the work went on without them.
